verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an identity-verification SaaS platform, but the evidence shows no first-party feature for defining scheduled or recurring workflows. The Zapier integration automates workflows in response to verification decisions, not on a schedule, and it runs on a third-party platform. The ongoing monitoring (OGM) webhook only says the service returns watchlist data, with no user-configurable recurring schedule documented. Both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
